author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 11/16/2018: SONO, NVDA, BB, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.73%
AAPL: -0.73%
IBM: -0.44%
CSCO: -0.36%
GOOG: -1.18%
Technology stocks were declining in early Friday trading.
Stocks moving on news include:
(+) Sonos ( SONO ), which was surging more than 18% after the company's fiscal fourth-quarter loss narrowed substantially from a year ago, exceeding market expectations, on record sales that handily beat the market consensus.
(-) NVIDIA ( NVDA ) was down more than 18% as it reported Q3 non-GAAP earnings of $1.84 per share, up 38% from the $1.33 per share posted a year ago but below the analyst consensus of $1.92 per share on Capital IQ.
In other sector news:
(+) BlackBerry ( BB ) was slightly higher after it signed a definitive agreement to acquire artificial intelligence and cybersecurity firm Cylance for $1.4 billion in cash, plus the assumption of unvested employee incentive awards.
